title: Adding and Taking Away to 10
seo_title: Grade R Adding and Taking Away Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve verbally stated addition and subtraction problems with solutions up to 10; use concrete apparatus, drawings and counting.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: adding and taking away to 10 with pictures, number sentences and sums to 5. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Adding puts groups together: count them all.
  • Taking away makes a group smaller: count what is left.
  • Count on from the first number: 5 and 2 more → 6, 7.
  • Use fingers, counters or a drawing.

Examples

Example

3 birds and 2 more birds

3, then 4, 5

Answer: 5 birds

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
One groupCount both groups.
Add or take awayTaken away means fewer.
Counting the start againCount on from the next number.
